description: Renovate keeps Coup Online's dependencies current. Weekly batched PRs, auto-merge for safe patches, manual review for broad-surface majors per SKILL.md § 2.

packageRules.description: ESLint stays on 9.x until eslint-plugin-react@8 lands stable. v10 breaks via context.getFilename() removal.
Group all non-major bumps into one weekly PR — less noise, easier review.
Auto-merge patch updates of dev dependencies after CI passes. Patch bumps on prod deps still need eyes-on.
Broad-surface deps need a migration plan on majors per SKILL.md § 2. Tag the PR so it doesn't auto-merge.
Cloudflare workers-types is published almost daily as date-stamped versions. Batch separately so it doesn't dominate the weekly digest.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security advisories bypass the weekly schedule. Don't auto-merge — a security PR deserves a human read even when the diff is small.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Periodically refresh the lockfile to pull in transitive-dep patches that don't trigger a top-level Renovate PR.
